name: m0saic-outreach
description: Personalized outreach video as a m0saic template repo: one template, one props file per recipient.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node tools/copy-assets.mjs && node dist/gen-template-manifest.js && node tools/check-registry.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:contract && npm run check:deps

//dependencies: The @m0saic/* substrate is on npm. The 0.x ranges (types, platform,
template-utils) track the m0saic CLI line; the language packages (dsl,
dsl-stdlib) version on their own. AUTHOR MODE (build / test / lint) is
`npm install && npm run verify` — no monorepo checkout, no file: links.
USING the repo: `npm run build` first. dist/ is NOT committed here (the
full starter commits it for a zero-build clone; this scaffold keeps
generated files out of your diffs). Once built, the app (Templates ->
Add source) and the CLI (--template-repo) load dist/index.js, and the
host resolves @m0saic/* from its own module tree at load time.
